Item.Name: SRC_SCHEDULE_TIME
Item.Hint: Enter schedule time in the format MM-DD-YY HH24:MI.

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
declare
 c_src_schedule_time date;
 c_hh number(2);
 c_mi number(2);
 c_date date;
 v_list_schedule_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 

BEGIN

 -- If src schedule time is null then populate src and dst schedule times.
 
 if :ctrl_block.src_schedule_time is null then
 
 

 select :multi_list_header.list_schedule_time --to_char(list_schedule_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 into v_list_schedule_time --:ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time
 from donor_list_header
 where list_id = :ctrl_block.dest_list_id;
 
 
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_list_schedule_time,v_local_time);
 
 :ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time := v_local_time;
 
 else
 :ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time := v_list_schedule_time;
 end if;

 :ctrl_block.src_list_id := :ctrl_block.source_list_id;
 :ctrl_block.dst_list_id := :ctrl_block.dest_list_id;

 -- Get src_schedule_time
 -- This is one minuite lessthan the dest_schedule_time
 
 c_date := to_date(substr(to_char(:ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time,'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi'),1,8),'MM-DD-RR');
 
 
 select to_number(substr(:ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time,10,2)),
 to_number(substr(:ctrl_block.dst_schedule_time,13,2))
 into c_hh,c_mi
 from dual;
 
 if c_mi >0 then
 c_mi := c_mi -1;
 elsif c_hh>0 then
 c_hh := c_hh -1;
 c_mi := 59;
 else
 c_date := c_date -1;
 c_hh :=23;
 c_mi :=59;
 end if;
 
 :ctrl_block.src_schedule_time := to_date( to_char(c_date,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||
 lpad(to_char(c_hh),2,'0')||':'||lpad(to_char(c_mi),2,'0'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');

 
 end if;

END;

PROCEDURE sequence_list (p_block_name varchar2,
 p_item_name varchar2) IS

 nCurrRec number := name_in('system.cursor_record');
 szCurrField varchar2(50) := name_in('system.cursor_field');
BEGIN
 loop
 copy(name_in('system.cursor_record'),
 p_block_name || '.' || p_item_name);
 if name_in('system.last_record') = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_record(nCurrRec);
 go_field(szCurrField);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'list_id'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 if p_window_name = 'DCWDCOMM' then
 -- this program needs user id for insert record
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_insert_user', TEXT_PARAMETER, :banner.user_id); 
 elsif p_window_name = 'DEWCRITN' THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_list_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :multi_list_header.list_id); 
 end if;
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_NEW_SEQUENCE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_new_sequence (p_list_seq number) RETURN NUMBER IS

 nOrigNo number := p_list_seq;
 nCurrNo number;
 nSeqNo number;
 nRtnValue number;


/* Removed by Lakshmi. Requested by Gauder 

 function get_lower_seq(p_test_seq number) return number is
 cursor cur_seq (p_seq number) is
 select max(list_seq)
 from donor_list_header
 where list_seq < p_test_seq;

 nSeq number := 0;
 begin
 open cur_seq(p_test_seq);
 fetch cur_seq 
 into nSeq;
 if cur_seq%isopen then
 close cur_seq;
 end if;
 return nSeq;
 end;


 function test_seq(p_test_seq number) return number is
 cursor cur_seq (p_seq number) is
 select count(*)
 from donor_list_header
 where list_seq = p_test_seq;

 nSeq number := 0;
 begin
 open cur_seq(p_test_seq);
 fetch cur_seq 
 into nSeq;
 if cur_seq%isopen then
 close cur_seq;
 end if;
 return nSeq;
 end;
*/




BEGIN
 select nvl(max(list_seq),0)
 into nCurrNo
 from donor_list_header
 where list_seq < p_list_seq;
 
 nRtnValue := (nCurrNo + p_list_seq) /2;
 
 return nRtnValue;




/* Removed by Lakshmi

 loop
 nCurrNo := get_lower_seq(nOrigNo);

 nSeqNo := round((p_list_seq - nCurrNo) / 2);
 nRtnValue := test_seq(nSeqNo);
 
 if nRtnValue = 0 then
 exit;
 else
 nOrigNo := round(nOrigNo / 2);
 if nOrigNo <= 5 then
 nSeqNo := -1;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
*/
 return nSeqNo;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_HOLD_STATUS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_hold_status IS
 cursor cur_hold is
 select parameter_value
 from valid_parameters
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and parameter_code = 'HOLD_ENLST'
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);

 szAlertMessage varchar2(300) := 'Application Admin has put all lists on hold ' || 
 'temporarily.' || new_line || 'No further action is required from you,' ||
 'once the hold is released, list generation will begin automatically.' ||
 new_line || 'Contact IS for more information.';

 id_alert ALERT := find_alert('hold_alert');
 szHoldStatus varchar2(10);
 nalertResponse number;
BEGIN
 open cur_hold;
 fetch cur_hold 
 into szHoldStatus;
 if cur_hold%notfound then
 szHoldStatus := 'FALSE';
 end if;
 if cur_hold%isopen then
 close cur_hold;
 end if;

 -- check to see if szHoldStatus is 'TRUE', if it is then display the 
 -- alert to the user.
 if szHoldStatus = 'TRUE' then
 if id_null(id_alert) then
 clear_message;
 message(szalertMessage, acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 message('');
 end if;
 set_alert_property(id_alert, alert_message_text, szAlertMessage);
 nAlertResponse := show_alert(id_alert);
 end if;
END;

and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
order by list_priority desc, list_seq
